welcome.title: Welcome to Pithyx
welcome.intro: This installs Pithyx {version} on this computer. It takes a few minutes and needs no internet connection.

checks.cpuFailed: The processor is too old. Pithyx needs a 64-bit processor with x86-64-v2 (SSE4.2 and POPCNT).
checks.uefiFailed: The computer started in legacy (BIOS) mode. Switch the firmware to UEFI, then start from the USB stick again.
checks.memory: At least {minGb} GB of memory ({foundGb} GB found)
checks.memoryFailed: Pithyx needs at least {minGb} GB of memory; this computer has {foundGb} GB.
checks.secure_bootFailed: Secure Boot is on. Pithyx uses a ZFS module that is not signed: switch Secure Boot off in the firmware settings (often under Security or Boot), then start from the USB stick again.
checks.disk: An internal disk of at least {minGb} GB
checks.diskFailed: No internal disk of at least {minGb} GB was found. USB disks and the USB stick cannot hold the system.

taken.title: Installation in use
taken.intro: Another browser is already installing Pithyx on this computer. To start over, restart the computer from the USB stick.

region.title: Name and region
region.hostnameHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Other devices see the box under this name.
region.ntpHint: Separated by commas. Leave empty for the defaults.

network.title: Network
network.intro: Pithyx gets its address by DHCP on every connected network card. A card can have a fixed address instead; Settings > Network has bonds, VLANs and more after the installation.
network.testing: Testing… The page may lose its connection for a few seconds.
network.dnsHint: Separated by spaces. Empty uses those DHCP announces.
network.after: After the installation the box answers at {address}.

disks.title: System disk
disks.intro: Pithyx is installed on one internal disk. Your data goes on other disks later, in Storage.
disks.mirrorHint: The system is written to both disks; the box keeps running when one of them fails.
disks.chooseSecond: Choose a second disk or switch the mirror off.
disks.hdd: Hard disk: it works, but an SSD is faster and quieter and uses less power.
disks.hasData: This disk holds data that will be erased.

reason.boot_medium: the USB stick of this installer

admin.title: Administrator
admin.intro: The first user of the box. It can add more users after the installation.

summary.title: Summary
summary.name: Name
summary.confirm: All data on these disks will be erased
summary.confirmRequired: Confirm that the data on these disks will be erased.

done.title: Pithyx is installed
done.recoveryIntro: This key is the only way to reset the administrator password. It is shown only now. Store it somewhere safe before you restart.

reboot.title: Remove the USB stick
reboot.intro: Remove the USB stick, then restart. The computer starts Pithyx from its disk, and this page opens it as soon as it answers.

rebooting.title: Pithyx is starting
rebooting.intro: This page opens the new system as soon as it answers. This can take a few minutes.
rebooting.certificate: The new system answers over HTTPS with a certificate it made itself, so your browser warns once. That is expected: continue to the page. Settings > Certificates explains how to trust the box on your devices.
